==English==
{{wp}}
[[File:Novembrska vinjeta (panjska končnica).jpg|thumb|[[Slovene]] illustration of ''November'' (1915)]]
[[File:Joachim von Sandrart - Der Monat November.jpg|thumb|''November'' by [[German]] painter [[w:Joachim von Sandrart|Joachim von Sandrart]] (1643)]]

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|Nov|Nov.|NOV||abbreviation}}
* {{alt|en|Novembre||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:Novembre<ety:bor<fro:novembre>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|Novembre}}, from {{der|en|fro|novembre}}, from {{der|en|la|November||ninth month}}, from Latin {{m|la|novem}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₁néwn̥||nine}}; + {{der|en|la|-ber}}, from {{m|la|-bris}}, an adjectival suffix. November was the ninth month in the Roman calendar.

Displaced native {{ncog|ang|blōtmōnaþ|lit=sacrifice month}}, so called because the {{w|Anglo-Saxons}}, when they were pagans, would sacrifice in this month before the winter set in.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/nəʊˈvɛmbə/|/nəˈvɛmbə/|a=UK}}
* {{enPR|nō-vĕmʹbər|a=US}}, {{IPA|en|/noʊˈvɛmbɚ/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-November.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/nəˈvɛmbə(r)/|a=Indic}}
* {{hyphenation|en|No|vem|ber}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛmbə(ɹ)|s=3}}

The second half of his hearing is set to begin Monday and end Wednesday.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251003002651/https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/13/us/myles-cosgrove-breonna-taylor-termination-appeal-hearing/index.html|archivedate=3 October 2025}}
